name: World Bank Documents & Reports

download.notes: Each document record exposes pdfurl (direct PDF) and often txturl (plain text). Example: http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/679601468208181189/pdf/multi0page.pdf . url field is the HTML record landing page. Some records lack pdfurl (metadata-only).

enrich.notes: The WDS search record is already rich (abstracts, docty, lang, count, entityids, topicv3). No separate detail call is normally needed; to expand fields just widen the fl (field list) param. For a single doc, filter by its guid/id. Full text available via txturl.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The World Bank Documents & Reports (WDS) API v3 exposes ~295k+ operational and research documents (procurement plans, working papers, project appraisals, environmental assessments, etc.). It is a flat REST/JSON API, no auth required. Endpoint: `https://search.worldbank.org/api/v3/wds`.

## Search
Free-text search uses `qterm`. Always pass `format=json`. Control returned fields with `fl` (comma-separated field list) to keep payloads small. Response top-level keys: `documents` (map of records keyed by id), `total` (int result count), `rows`, `os`, `page`, `facets`.

## Filters
Verified working params: `strdate` / `enddate` (date range, `YYYY-MM-DD`), `lang_exact` (language, e.g. `English`), `docty_exact` (document type — use exact facet labels such as `Working Paper`, `Project Appraisal Document`), `count` (country, e.g. `Kenya`), `owner` (owning unit). Retrieve valid facet values by calling with `rows=0&fct=docty_exact` — response returns `facets.docty_exact` map of `{name,count}`. Note: `docty_exact` requires the exact canonical label; a wrong label silently returns `total:0`.

## Download
Each record carries `pdfurl` (direct PDF link) and frequently `txturl` (plain-text extraction, ideal for full-text ingestion) plus `url` (HTML landing page). Download PDFs directly from `pdfurl` — no bitstream indirection.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Records are self-contained: `display_title`, `docdt` (ISO datetime), `docty`, `lang`, `count`, `abstracts`, `entityids`, `topicv3`, `guid`. No secondary enrich request needed — widen `fl` instead. Full text via `txturl`.

## Limitations
Pagination uses `os` (offset, 0-based) with `rows` page size. Very large offsets may be rate-limited. `docty_exact` label mismatches fail silently (empty result). Not every document has a `pdfurl`.
probeNotes: GET https://search.worldbank.org/api/v3/wds?qterm=water&format=json&rows=2 -> top keys rows,os,page,total(208872+),documents,facets; record fields id,count,docty,lang,entityids,docdt,abstracts,display_title,pdfurl,txturl,guid,url; pdfurl example http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/679601468208181189/pdf/multi0page.pdf, docdt 1972-12-01T05:00:00Z. Confirmed strdate=2021-01-01&enddate=2021-01-31&lang_exact=English -> returned doc docdt 2021-01-21, lang English (filters honored). Confirmed count=Kenya -> returned Kenya document. Confirmed fct=docty_exact -> facets.docty_exact list (Procurement Plan 97683, Working Paper 7752, Project Appraisal Document 3982, ...). Note docty_exact=Working%20Paper with an unrelated count_exact returned 0 (count_exact is not the right country param; the working param is count).
